:Pega Developer
Company Description
Role:Pega Developer
Location:    Hoboken, NJ
Duration:    Fulltime

Overview:
Perform workflow development and design activities to support the client's applications and ensuring the highest software standards.
Responsibilities:
To design and develop applications based on Pega 5.5 and Pega 6.3.
Apply development skills and technology during development
Design, develop, prototype, and test of the required subsystem and its interface to the system
Manage the day-to-day activities working with a small team of software developers
Interface with project stakeholders to ensure that the system objectives are balanced with overall project objectives
Provide design ideas to the leadership of the project team
Represent the team as required
Assist management in the development of design policies and procedures which improve the ability to meet requirements
Communicate with peers and supervisors routinely, document work, meetings, and decisions
Work within a Project Team environment
Understand and promote the quality policy
Maintain technical skills and awareness of technical improvements
Requirements:
Must:
Should have in depth hands on experience on Pega 5.5 and Pega 6.3.
Should have very good communication and client facing skills.
Understanding the business requirements and interpret the requirements from Pega PRPC perspective
Support the client communications with both business and architecture teams for functional clarifications and design discussions respectively
Ability to adapt quickly to an existing, complex environment
Should be a self-motivated, independent, detail oriented, responsible team-player
Passionate about building high-quality systems
Strong verbal and written communication skills
Strong analytical skills able to identify alternatives, presenting options, and making recommendations to meet the projects goals
Good Problem solving abilities
EOE/Minority/Female/Veteran/Disabled

Qualifications
To design and develop applications based on Pega 5.5 and Pega 6.3.

Additional Information

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
